messages:
nina_ae: FYI - TerraHealth POC blocked: their SecOps will only accept TLS client authentication (mTLS) to upstream inference endpoints. They refuse to rely solely on IP allowlisting. Need a quick plan for Dedicated POC (1 week).

owen_se: Short take: We don't publish client-cert auth as a standard option for hosted/dedicated endpoints. Options for a fast POC: 1) provide static NAT egress IPs from a reserved Dedicated pool so they can allowlist; 2) enable a temporary client-cert fingerprint check at our edge (manual infra + security exception); 3) recommend Private/VPC but that's longer lead.

terra-netops: Procurement won't approve extra infra on our side. They prefer an auth model. If Redwood can do cert pinning for a week that solves it.

jamal_infra: We can reserve two /32s from our NAT pool inside 8 hours. For cert pinning we can add a manual fingerprint check on the TLS listener, but it requires a security-approved waiver and a short maintenance window to apply. Not automated.

sasha_security: Security position: temporary cert acceptance is allowed for a bounded POC only if: - cert TTL <= 7 days; - customer-signed CSR preferred; - documented issuance & revocation steps; - internal exception ticket filed. We'll also require an audit entry showing TLS auth success events.

owen_se: Copy-paste items for Terra to drop into their firewall/change request (use as-is):
```
# TerraHealth - Redwood Dedicated POC allowlist
198.51.100.77/32   # dedicated pool egress IP A
198.51.100.78/32   # dedicated pool egress IP B
# destination: dedicated-terra.pool.redwood.ai:443
```

owen_se: If we enable client cert pinning, give them this curl test to validate once certs are in place:
```
curl --cacert redwood-ca.pem \
  --cert terra-client.pem --key terra-client.key \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <DEDICATED-API-KEY>" \
  https://dedicated-terra.pool.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jamal_infra: Action items I will take: (A) open INF ticket to reserve NAT IPs and confirm exact addresses (ETA 8h); (B) estimate window to apply manual TLS fingerprint (need sign-off from security) and post rollback.

sasha_security: I'll prepare the SEC-POC waiver template and the minimal risk assessment. We'll accept a customer CSR delivered over the secure portal; avoid issuing certs ourselves unless strictly necessary.

terra-netops: CSR preferred. Can you provide the exact CN/SAN they should use so our PKI team can auto-issue?

owen_se: Provide CN=terra-poc-client and SAN=email:terra-poc@terrahealth.com. Accept ECDSA P-256 or RSA2048. We'll accept PEM encoded CSR uploaded to our secure portal.

nina_ae: Can infra and security confirm whether we can show TLS auth events in a signed audit extract? Customer wants evidence for compliance team.

sasha_security: Yes we can provide a signed audit extract limited to auth success/failure timestamps and subject fingerprint. No raw connection data. We'll attach it to the waiver.

jamal_infra: INF-5120 opened to reserve IPs and track the manual TLS change. Once IPs are reserved I'll post back the exact addresses.

deploy-bot: [ticket] INF-5120 created by jamal_infra - reserved NAT placeholders pending allocation

nina_ae: Great. I'll tell Terra we'll try static IPs + optional cert pinning for defense-in-depth and circle back when INF-5120 has the concrete IPs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
